# DrainBar 0.3.3
Claude credential access is more resilient.
- Background checks, startup, and wake no longer display Keychain password prompts. Choose Refresh when access needs approval. - A still-valid Claude credential stays in memory during temporary Keychain access problems. No extra token copy is saved to disk. - DrainBar detects replacement credentials and retries once with a newer token before reporting an expired sign-in. - Removed credentials and explicit Keychain denial clear the retained credential.
Claude Code continues to manage sign-in and token renewal.
